event.description: Factor learned absolute positions through a rank-3 code
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 5 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0030, which removed the never-forwarded positional row and qualified at 2,128 parameters and 99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0025, whose centered affine rank-10 positional SVD scored 32.44% at 3,018 parameters. Hypothesis: after 329 retained scalar unions have compressed the absolute table to 182 groups, its task-relevant geometry may now lie in a three-dimensional learned subspace even though earlier dense-table rank-10 projections failed. This is a major representational change: replace grouped absolute scalars with 32x3 learned codes and a 3x16 projection initialized by best rank-3 SVD, yielding 1,634 parameters. It is more informative than rank 4 because rank-4 factors require 192 parameters and are not strictly smaller than the current 182-group table; rank 3 is the highest eligible learned positional factorization under the current frontier. Token representation, attention, autoregressive logits, and generic decoding remain unchanged.
